stem:
Chirag measures the temperature of four cups of tea left in different rooms of his house in Pune.

Cup P reads 42 °C, Cup Q reads 55 °C, Cup R reads 38 °C, and Cup S reads 47 °C.

Which cup of tea is the hottest?

options.text: Cup P, because 42 is closer to body temperature
Cup R, because a lower reading means hotter tea
Cup S, because its cup is the darkest brown

teacher.key_rationale: On the same Celsius scale, the highest reading is hottest. Cup Q at 55 °C is hottest. Closeness to body temperature, reversing high/low, or cup colour do not decide hotness.
